recipe.title: Sour Peach & Peachy Ring Protein Snack
recipe.summary: A candy-like sour peach protein puff, refreshing Peachy Ring clear protein, and a hard-boiled egg make an easy one-minute snack with approximately 42 grams of protein.
recipe.story: I love keeping a few quick protein picks on hand for the days when I have no time and do not want to think about food. The Sweet Peach Punch Sour Puff satisfies a candy craving, the Peachy Ring clear protein is light and refreshing, and the boiled egg adds something savory and filling. Having combinations like this ready makes it much easier to grab something that supports my goals instead of choosing whatever happens to be fastest.
ingredients: 1 BUILT Sweet Peach Punch Sour Puff
1 serving Clean Simple Eats Peachy Ring Clear Protein Powder
Cold water and ice, according to the protein powder package directions
instructions: Mix the Peachy Ring clear protein powder with cold water and ice according to the package directions.
Place the unopened Sweet Peach Punch Sour Puff on a small plate.
Add the peeled hard-boiled egg beside the wrapped protein puff.
Serve with the Peachy Ring clear protein drink and enjoy.
tips: Keep hard-boiled eggs prepared in the refrigerator so the entire snack is ready in about two minutes.
The sour peach protein puff and Peachy Ring drink satisfy a candy-like craving, while the egg adds a savory and filling element.
Keep individual protein powder servings, wrapped protein puffs, and prepared eggs available for an easy no-think snack.
Product nutrition can change, so use the numbers printed on your packages when tracking.

Nutrition is approximate and is based on one 150-calorie BUILT Sweet Peach Punch Sour Puff, one 100-calorie serving of Clean Simple Eats Peachy Ring Clear Protein Powder, and one large hard-boiled egg.
